bio: While the natural world may be serene and lifegiving, it's also violent, venomous, and disgusting. Wyvold is the embodiment of that rabid wildness, brought forth by the ancient Eldrin to vanquish anyone who would try to besmirch the Emerald Kingdom. The modern-day Eldrin are hesitant to call on Wyvold's power, for if not controlled, its fetid jaws could putrefy the entire kingdom.
